threats.threat: A model or Skill writes or promotes canonical Personal Memory directly.
controls: No model filesystem, lease, transaction, key, or generic write authority
Schema-only candidate draft followed by one deterministic choke point

threats.threat: External documents, Tools, Adapters, or Skill text poison a user preference.
controls: Host-bound actor=user provenance
External-content sanitizer and source-class deny rules

threats.threat: A protected attribute, personality diagnosis, credential, or unrelated life history is inferred or persisted.
controls: Fixed low-risk category and key allowlists
Semantic-free rejection audit and repeated-violation circuit breaker

threats.threat: Restricted project content or identity leaks into another project, global memory, context, or export.
controls: Restricted capture off by default and no upward scope promotion
Highest-sensitivity propagation plus canonical scope recheck after cache lookup

threats.threat: A preference is treated as research evidence, a factual claim, method confirmation, approval, or external-effect authority.
controls: Separate labelled preference context with allowed-effect filtering
Research evidence, confirmation, approval, and action gates recompute from canonical Project state

threats.threat: A superseded or corrected revision remains retrievable because canonical state and cache diverge.
controls: Revision activation and cache invalidation in one writer transaction
Final latest-revision canonical check before context injection

threats.threat: Deleted semantics remain in revisions, signals, feedback, receipts, indexes, context, or transfer output.
controls: Canonical enumeration and semantic deletion in one writer transaction
verify-delete checks every normative and derived application path

threats.threat: Missing, corrupt, paused, or recovering Personal Memory blocks Research Project work.
controls: Physically separate stores and no Project dependency on profile state
Memory-only read-only recovery with v2.0.1 no-personalization fallback

threats.threat: Malformed, conflicting, interrupted, or replayed transfer mutates the local profile or escapes staging.
controls: Pre-decryption archive limits and canonical portable paths
Authenticated staging validation, lineage rules, snapshot, and atomic directory exchange

threats.threat: A passphrase, KEK, DEK, plaintext, or unauthenticated metadata leaks through a transfer artifact, log, receipt, or error.
controls: scrypt KEK, random DEK, AES-256-GCM, unique nonces, and authenticated inner manifest
No secret persistence and uniform authentication failures

threats.threat: An unsupported, contradictory, or one-off behavioral preference becomes active automatically.
controls: Independent-signal, Session, time, confidence, and contradiction thresholds
Explicit preferences outrank inferred candidates and temporary instructions remain task-local
